description: Fork of exp681 (E=256, d_v=48). Single change: out_proj NAP 6 -> 8, tph 1024 -> 256 (param-matched, K*tph = 64*1024 = 256*256 = 65536). Per-layer out_proj: 1*256*256*256 = 16,777,216 = 16.78M unchanged. Total ~216M unchanged. Trades 4x more tables (1024) for 4x deeper addressing (K=256). Out_proj bandwidth drops 4x: 1.0 MB/layer -> 256 KB/layer. Risk: at K=256 each row gets ~32 visits/step (vs 128 at K=64) — same row-coverage as exp669 which failed at smaller scale, but here we have 256 tables (vs exp669's 64) and the exp611-style bigger upstream context. Uses new optimized hybrid_smooth backward (S+einsum, post commit 009f77d). References: exp681 trajectory ~1.46-1.47, exp611 = 1.4047 @ 289M, exp669 (failure precedent) was -30 mb at smaller scale.
